      "evidence": "Modifies .github/workflows/ci.yml and ci/test/ scripts to drop privileged container execution and remove BCC toolchain setup.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Dropping privileged container mode in the ASan CI task simplifies CI environment maintenance and tightens security. The PR description notes that 'The ASan CI job no longer needs a privileged container and uses SYS_PTRACE instead,' reducing CI configuration overhead."
    },

      "name": "docs",

      "rationale": "Documentation adjustments merely document the transition to GDB-based USDT testing and follow the test infrastructure work."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Rewrites the USDT functional test harness in test/functional/test_framework/usdt.py and updates five interface_usdt_*.py test suites.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replacing BCC and eBPF with GDB eliminates a heavy external dependency and root privilege requirement for running tracepoint tests. Per the PR description, 'All five tests can run with GDB and binutils, without BCC or matching kernel headers,' substantially reducing contributor friction and removing hundreds of lines of complex embedded BPF test code."
